name: GET /api/users/permission-matrix - The SOP §28 grid, as the PDP decides it
description: Returns one row per SOP actor, each carrying the policy decision point's own verdict for every action in the bundle, with denials dropped so the grid shows what a role HOLDS beside what it must ESCALATE. Proves criterion 4c12f924-87d1-4be1-b790-d94a936d58b3#AC3, the permission matrix is reachable from the UI and remains read-only: the response states editable=false and names its source files, and there is deliberately NO companion write endpoint. Roles and policies are versioned code in server/src/config/roles.ts and policies.ts; an endpoint that edited them would make the policy set per-tenant configuration when it is the one thing in this system that must have exactly one source. The verdicts come from evaluate(), the SAME function that decides whether a request may proceed - rendering ROLE_DEFINITIONS directly would ignore POLICY_OVERRIDES and show audit.delete_event as available to Leadership with approval when the bundle denies it to everyone unconditionally, and a matrix that disagrees with enforcement on the one rule with no escalation path is worse than no matrix. Behind authenticate, not role-gated, for the same reason as GET /api/users/roles. QA: depends on register and login for the bearer token.

testCases.name: Nine SOP actors, and the grid states that it cannot be edited here
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
